nodes.description: A heterozygous germline SLC16A1 variant is proposed to reduce the lactate/proton transport capacity of monocarboxylate transporter 1 (MCT1) in erythrocyte and skeletal-muscle membranes. Reported carriers had erythrocyte lactate transport rates of roughly 40-50% of normal. Attribution to the specific historical missense variants is uncertain (see Genetic notes); the measured transport phenotype itself is reproducible.
